data.title: Playground Shadow Detectives
data.description: Explore the playground and discover how shadows change length and direction as the sun moves across the sky from morning to afternoon!

challenges.instruction: Look at where the sun is in the sky at 8:00 AM. What will Maya's shadow look like?
challenges.hint: Remember, when the sun is low in the morning sky, shadows stretch out far on the opposite side!

challenges.instruction: The clock hits 12:00 PM and the sun is high overhead. Predict Maya's shadow now!
challenges.hint: Think about what happens to your shadow when the sun shines straight down from high up in the sky at lunchtime.

challenges.instruction: It is now 4:00 PM and the sun is getting lower on the other side. What is your prediction for Maya's shadow?
challenges.hint: When the sun is low in the late afternoon, shadows stretch out long towards the side where the sun is setting.
